faq.title: Bulk Resize Images — FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about how to bulk resize images online

items.question: Is the bulk resize images tool really free?
items.answer: Yes! You can bulk resize images for free with no limitations. No watermarks, no daily caps, and no account required.

items.question: How does the batch resizer work?
items.answer: Upload multiple images at once, choose your resize settings (percentage, exact dimensions, or target file size), and click resize. Our tool will bulk resize images right in your browser — nothing is uploaded to a server.

items.question: What image formats can I bulk resize?
items.answer: You can bulk resize images in JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats. The tool also lets you change the output format, so you can resize and convert at the same time.

items.question: Is it safe to resize images with this tool?
items.answer: Absolutely. When you bulk resize images here, all processing happens locally in your browser. Your files never leave your device, and you can even work offline after loading the page.

items.question: Can I resize images to specific dimensions?
items.answer: Yes! You can resize by percentage, exact pixel dimensions (width × height), target width, target height, longest side, or target file size. We also provide quick presets for popular social media sizes.

items.question: Why did my file size increase after resizing?
items.answer: This can happen when your settings produce highly detailed outputs. To keep files small when you bulk resize images, try using WebP format and set quality to 80% or below. Also check that images aren't being upscaled beyond their original resolution.
